text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: For many years, the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE and the beastfolk tribes had been at odds. But after Matsuri and Christina attended the peace negotiations as ambassadors, the winds began to shift.
text_block_list.orig_text:
長らく対立していた【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】と獣人族。
しかし、マツリとクリスティーナが大使として赴いた和平交渉以降、
大きく風向きが変わってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Not everyone had opened their hearts yet, but a growing sense that "we should understand one another and meet halfway" had begun to take root.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全ての人々が心を開いたわけではないものの、
「理解しあい、歩み寄るべきである」という風潮が強まってきたのだ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: For Matsuri -- herself a beastfolk member of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE -- that shift was an encouraging tailwind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは獣人族でありながら【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に
所属しているマツリにとって、心強い追い風となっていた……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Maaaan, at first I thought it'd be impossible for me to act as some kind of peace ambassador, but somehow the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE have gotten more easygoing lately, so it was well worth the effort!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～、
最初は和平大使なんて絶対ムリって思ってたッスけど、
なんだか
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】も風通しがよくなって、
がんばった甲斐があったッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: But, the path to become a true hero is still a long one... This is just the start. I've gotta work way harder so they'll recognize me as a full-fledged knight already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
まだまだ真のヒーローへの道は遠い……
これは
きっかけにすぎないッス、
もっともっと努力して、
早く一人前の団員だって認めてもらえるようにならないと！

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Admirable attitude. But first, some advice: stop shouting your monologues while on guard duty. It's embarrassing to watch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかそうか、
それは感心だ。
そのためにまず一つアドバイスだが、
立ち番をしているときに
デカい声で独り言を言うのはやめろ、
見ていて恥ずかしくなる。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: AAAAHHH?! M-M-My deepest apologies, Captain! I'll be talking to myself in a low voice from now on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあっ！？
しし、
失礼したッス
隊長！
今後は
小さい声で独り言を言うことにするッス！

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: No, you should just quiet down entirely and do your job. ...That said, your performance lately has been impressive. So I'd like to assign you a mission you haven't taken on before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
黙って仕事をしてくれ。
……ただ、
最近の働きぶりが見事なのは
その通りだ。
そこで、
今までとは違う任務を任せたいと思っていてな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A mission... that I've never done before! Does that mean it's supposed to be a super important, hero-like special mission?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今までとは、
違う任務……！
それってもしかして、
超重要な、
ヒーローっぽい特殊任務だったりするんスか！？

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course! And its name is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
もちろん！
その名も……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...Lost-and-found duty.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……落とし物係。

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't look so blatantly disappointed! It's an honorable part of the duties of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE! I'm assigning a part-timer to work with you too, so play nice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
露骨にがっかりするな！
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の立派な業務の一環だぞ！
お前と一緒にバイトも現場に入れるから、
仲良くやれ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: {0}, you're on lost-and-found duty too?! I can't believe that all the members who worked so hard on the peace negotiations for the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE are now in charge of such a simple job!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんも落とし物係になったんスか！？
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の和平交渉をがんばった
メンバーが
揃って落とし物係なんて、
納得できないッス～！！

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Shut up! The head of the lost and found department is threatening me too, saying: "I'll quit if you don't find me more hands this month!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
やかましい！
こっちだって
落とし物係の係長から
「今月人員補充がなかったら辞めます」
って脅されてるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's quite a request for a department that seemingly has a lot of free time in their hands... Isn't this job just to manage lost and found items?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかヒマそうな部署なのに、
ずいぶんな要求ッスね……
落とし物の管理をするだけでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Sure, this department takes in lost items from citizens and listens to people looking for things they've misplaced, checking whether anything matching their description has been turned in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
ここは市民から届けられた落とし物を受け付けたり、
逆に落とし物を捜している市民から話を聞いて、
該当する物品が届いてないか確認する部署ではある。

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: But, whether or not it truly has so much free time as you say is something you'll have to find out yourself. ...It'll be a good social learning experience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが、
ヒマかどうかは
身をもって確かめるがいい。
……いい社会勉強になるだろう。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: He said something that sounded very meaningful and just left... Is the lost and found department really that dangerous?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか、
ずいぶん意味深なこと言って去っていったッス……
そんなにヤバい部署なんスか、
落とし物係って？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...I see. You haven't heard much about it either except that it's a really busy work environment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど、
そっちも
すごく忙しいってこと以外は、
ほとんど何も聞かされてないんスね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Well, then there's no real point worrying about it, pal! For now, let's go in and check this out for ourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
悩んでても仕方ないッス！
とりあえず中に入って、
どんなお仕事か見てみるッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hello! Starting today, I have been reassigned...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは～！
自分、
今日から配属になった……

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 1
text_block_list.text: You guys, could it be...! Have our requests finally been listened?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
君たちは……！
やっと申請が通ったのか！？

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 2
text_block_list.text: More people... More people have finally arrived...
text_block_list.orig_text:
増員だ……
増員が来た
ぞぉ～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with this gloomy atmosphere...? All the pals working here are hunched over and sighing...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
なんなんスか、
このどんよりした雰囲気……
働いてる人たち、
ことごとく
猫背でため息ついてるんスけど……？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the lost and found department. I'm the chief in charge here, nice to meet you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようこそ、
落とし物係へ。
私がここを取り仕切っている係長よ、
よろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness. So there's someone who looks healthy in here! Um, why does everyone look so depressed, pal? It caught me by surprise when I came in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった、
顔色のよさそうな人もいるッス……！
あの～、
なんでみんな
元気がなさそうなんスか？
入ってきたとき
びっくりしちゃったッス。

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: I guess they're just feeling a little tired from day-to-day work. This happens to be a wonderful workplace where young people can get promoted quickly with a homey atmosphere, so don't be afraid and do your best♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
日々の疲れが溜まってるだけよ。
ここはアットホームな雰囲気で
若手でもすぐに昇進できる
素敵な職場だから、
怖がらないで
がんばってちょうだいね♪

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hearing that really makes me feel relieved and motivated! By the way, what should we do, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを聞いたら安心したし、
やる気も出てきたッス！
ところで、
自分は何をしたらいいんスか？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: You'll be working at the front desk. Please deal with the citizens and prepare the necessary documents. There's a sample in the cabinet on how to write them, so use that as a reference.
text_block_list.orig_text:
窓口業務をお願いするわ。
市民への対応と、
それに伴う書類の作成をやってちょうだい。
書き方はキャビネットに見本があるから、
それを参考にして。

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 2
text_block_list.text: That's about it... Make sure you don't make any mistakes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだよぉ～……
間違えないようにねぇ～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: T-Thanks... But at a quick glance, it doesn't seem like a difficult set of documents to prepare. It's a good thing I practiced paperwork during the peace negotiations♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうも……
でも見た感じ、
そんな難しそうな書類じゃないッス。
和平交渉の時に、
書類仕事の練習をしといてよかったッス♪

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that's reassuring to hear♪ Well then, it's about time we open up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
それは頼もしいわね♪
それじゃ、
さっそく……

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: EVERYONE! GET TO YOUR POOOOOOOSTS!
text_block_list.orig_text:
総員、
構えぇぇぇ～い！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: EEEEEKKK!? Huh? Wh-What...? What's going on all of a sudden?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいっ！？
えっ、
なに、
なんなんスか、
急にどうしたんスか！？

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 1
text_block_list.text: It's reception time... they're coming...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
受付時間だ……
奴らが
来る……！

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 2
text_block_list.text: The front desk... is open...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
窓口、
開きま～す……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, is this just because we're opening the front desk, pals? It's not like we're going to fight or anything, sounds to me like you're exaggerating...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
窓口開けるだけッスか？
別に戦いに行くわけじゃないのに、
大げさ過ぎるんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Citizen 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, I dropped my wallet. Could you have found it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ、
財布落としたんだけど
届いてないか！？

text_block_list.name: Citizen 2
text_block_list.text: Umm, I dropped the key to my house...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～、
家の鍵を落としちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Citizen 3
text_block_list.text: I picked this thing up, but I've no idea what to do with it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを拾ったんだけど、
どうすればいいのかねぇ～

text_block_list.name: Citizens
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'd like to talk to you about a lost item.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～、
落とし物の相談したいんですけど～？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-WHAT THE HELL IS THIS?! It's only been a short while since we've opened the front desk, but it's already filled with people seeking for a consultation as far as the eye can see!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ななな、
なんなんスかコレ～！？
窓口開けて
ちょっとしか経ってないのに、
もう見渡す限り
相談者で埋め尽くされてるんスけど！？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: DON'T JUST DILLY DALLY LIKE THAT! If we don't take care of them one by one, they'll bottle us in! Now hurry up and handle the citizens' requests!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボサっとしてるんじゃあない！
次々片付けていかないと、
押し込まれるぞ！
とっとと市民どもの相談を切り返せ～！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: EEEEKKKK!? The chief too! Her personality did a 180 from before! What should we do, pal?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃぃ～！？
係長も、
さっきまでと人格が変わっちゃってるッス！
どうしたらいいんスか～！？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it! That soft-spoken lad there gets it! If you don't want complaints stuffed into the suggestion box, then move!! Citizens aren't going to wait around for a pair of hatchlings!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通りだ、
そっちの優男はよく分かってるじゃないか！
目安箱にクレームを投函されたくなかったら対応しろ！！
市民はお前らヒヨッコの判断を待ったりなどせんのだ！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: R-Roger that! That said... who should we even start with, pal?! There's not even a line so I don't know who's been waiting or what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
りょ、
了解ッス！
といっても、
いったいどれから手をつけたらいいんスか！？
順番待ちの列すら
分からなくなってるッスよ！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're right pal, this must be a dream. There's no way the lost and found department would be this hellish, and there's no way we'd have to deal with something like this on our first day here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッスね、
きっと
これは夢ッス。
落とし物係がこんな地獄みたいな部署のはずないし、
配属初日の自分たちにこんなの対応できるわけ……

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: Don't turn a blind eye to reality, you chicks! The citizens won't wait until you're grown to be chickens, so hurry up and handle this rabble!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
現実から目を背けるんじゃない、
ヒヨッコども！
お前らがニワトリになるまで市民は待ったりせんのだ、
さっさと相談を捌いていけ～！！

text_block_list.name: Citizen 3
text_block_list.text: Umm, I picked this up. I think the person who dropped this item might be in trouble right now. Can someone listen to me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～、
これを拾ったんだけどねぇ～
落とした人、
困ってると思うんだよねぇ～
誰か、
話を聞いてくれんかねぇ～

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's hear what this old woman has to say! Let's see... it looks like a tattered black hoodie, where did you find it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
この人のお話からお伺いするッス！
ええっと、
見たところ
ボロボロの黒いフードみたいッスけど、
どこで拾ったんスか？

text_block_list.name: Citizen 3
text_block_list.text: In the garbage dump behind a restaurant, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
定食屋の裏の、
ゴミ捨て場だよ～

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, it was something thrown away as trash? Um, do we have to accept this as a lost item too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……つまり、
ゴミとして捨ててあったのでは？
あの、
これも落とし物として受け付けなきゃダメなんスか？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: Of course we do, you little rookie! Anything that you can't be sure isn't lost is lost! Even if it's just a rag used to wipe up milk, you have to prepare the necessary paperwork and accept it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前だヒヨッコ！
落とし物ではないと断言できないものは全部落とし物だ！
それが牛乳を拭いた後の雑巾だろうが、
書類を作って受理しろ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: G-Got it, pal! Let's see, all I need to ask is the time when it was picked up... and the name and address of the person who delivered it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったッス！
ええっと、
あと聞かなきゃいけないのは拾った時間と、
届けてくれた人の名前と住所と……

text_block_list.name: Citizen 1
text_block_list.text: What are you being so carefree about?! Instead of worrying about that rubbish, I want you to find my wallet! Without it, I can't even have lunch today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにを呑気にやってるんだよ！
そんなゴミのことより、
俺の財布を捜してくれよ！
あれがないと、
今日の昼めしだって食えないんだぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Your turn! Wait for your turn, pal! Let's see, what should I do here...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
順番、
順番にお願いするッス！
ええっと、
どうすれば……！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're a lifesaver, pal! If we don't split up and deal with all of them, this front desk's gonna get crushed by the crowd!
text_block_list.orig_text:
助かるッス～！
手分けしてどんどん捌いていかないと、
窓口が人混みで押しつぶされちゃいそうッスよ～！

text_block_list.name: Citizen 2
text_block_list.text: Please help me find my house key! It's silver, about this big!
text_block_list.orig_text:
家の鍵、
捜してください～！
色は銀色で、
これくらいの大きさなんですけど～！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, I'm on it! Which paperwork do I check for items we've already received!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
ただいま～！
届いてる落とし物って、
どの書類を見たらいいんスか！？

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 1
text_block_list.text: This is our inventory! And for the record... we've had over three hundred silver keys turned in just today...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが目録だ！
ちなみに銀色の鍵は、
今日までに300件以上届いている……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...You're kidding, right? You want me to search through all of those?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……マジッスか？
その中から
捜せってことッスか？

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: All you have to do is check when the key was dropped and only look at the keys that arrived after that! Find out more about the consultation from the person seeking advice and run to the warehouse! FULL SPEED!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつ落としたのか確認して、
それ以降に届いた鍵だけ見ればいいんだ！
相談者から状況を聞き出して、
倉庫に走れ！　
全速力だ！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAAAAAH!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひゃあ～！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: S-Somehow I've made it through that rush... I wonder what would have happened if {0} hadn't been there... Or rather, never in my dreams would I have imagined the lost and found department would be like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんとか
ラッシュは乗り切ったッス……
{0}さんがいなかったら、
どうなってたことか……
というか、
落とし物係って
こんなに忙しかったんスか……？

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 1
text_block_list.text: That's right. All lost items from all over Landosol are collected here. And it's the capital, so you can imagine how many live here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのとおり。
ランドソル中の落とし物がここに集まるんだ。
首都で、
たくさんの人が住んでるから……

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Man 2
text_block_list.text: No one knows about it, but there are an incredible number of lost items... It's like they say, little by little, it makes a big difference...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな知らないだけで、
とんでもない数の落とし物があるんだよぉ～……
ちりも積もれば、
なんとやらってやつだねぇ～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: No wonder there were so many huge warehouses. I didn't expect a lost items department would be this harsh. And we got yelled at nonstop by the people coming in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうりで、
でっかい倉庫がいくつもあったわけッス。
まさか
落とし物係がこんな過酷な部署だったなんて。
相談者から
いっぱい文句も言われるし。

text_block_list.name: Lost&Found Chief
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone! I have a meeting with the Commander about expanding our warehouses, so I won't be back by the regular time, but I'll leave the rest to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
お疲れさま！
私はこれから団長と
倉庫の増設についての会議があって
定時まで戻れないけど、
あとはよろしく！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really? Well then, I guess we'll go with our senpais...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そうなんスか？
それじゃあ、
先輩たちに従って……

text_block_list.name: Lost Item Section Men 1 and 2
text_block_list.text: We just finished a night shift, so we're heading home early... the rest's on you~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜勤明けで早上がりなんで……
あとはよしなに～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: No way, please wait a second, pals! Don't just leave the newbies behind! Isn't this supposed to be a homely workplace?! Hey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな、
待ってほしいッス！
新人だけ置き去りにしないでほしいッス～！
アットホームな職場じゃなかったんスか、
ちょっと～！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Aaah, they're gone... But we've finished dealing with all the people in line waiting for a consultation, so maybe things will be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
行っちゃった……
でも、
並んでた相談者も
一通り対応は終わってるし、
なんとかなりそうではあるッスね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...Though there's still a mountain of documents that we've failed to compile on time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……作成が間に合ってない書類は、
山のように残ってるッスけど。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hmm...! Somehow, that's a wrap on the paperwork. It's almost time to go pal, so all that's left is to close the counter and wait for the section chief to return.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
書類の方もなんとか片付いたッスね～
もう定時だし、
あとは窓口を閉じて
係長の帰りを待つだけッス。

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Um, apologies to bother you outside of reception time. I'd like you to check if you've received some black gloves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
受付時間外に申し訳ない。
黒い手袋が届いていないか確認してほしいのだが。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? Umm... Ugh?! Even just from the things that arrived today, there's a lot of matching descriptions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい？　
え～っと……
うっ！？
今日届いたものだけでも、
いっぱいそれっぽいのがあるッス。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If you do know you're outside reception time then just come tomorrow, pal~ I'm sure he'll be fine without some gloves for a night, so I'll just have to convince him to come back later...
text_block_list.orig_text:
時間外って分かってるなら、
明日にしてほしいッスよ～
手袋なんて
今日一日なくたって大丈夫だろうし、
やんわりと説得して
出直してもらうッス……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! You're going to listen to this man's request? You do know reception hours are already over, right, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
この人の話、
聞いてあげるんスか？
もう受付時間、
終わってるッスよ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...The old man came all the way here because he wanted help? So you think it'd be wrong not to help him...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おじいさんは
助けてほしいから、
ここまで来た？
だから、
助けてあげないのは
ダメだと思う……？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
その……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. Sorry, pal, but can I ask you to do the paperwork? I'll run to the warehouse and grab every black glove that came in recently!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうッスね。
申し訳ないッスけど、
書類だけお願いしてもいいッスか？
自分、
倉庫から
最近届いた黒い手袋、
全部持ってくるッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Old man, help me check them out when I return. There's a chance yours is among them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじいさん、
それを一緒に確認しましょう。
もしかしたら、
届いてるかもしれないッスから！

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Sorry... and thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまない、
ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: These...! These are the gloves I was looking for...! Thank goodness, you really had them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだよ、
この手袋だ……！
よかった、
届いていたんだな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's great, pal! Are they, like, expensive or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
よかったッス！
もしかして、
高級品だったりするんスか？

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: No, they're handmade. My wife knitted them for me a long time ago.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
手作りだよ。
ずっと昔、
妻が私に編んでくれたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: I meant to take good care of them, but I still managed to lose them... I guess I'm getting too old... It's been a long time since she died.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大切にしていたはずなのに、
落としてしまうなんて。
年を取りすぎてしまったようだ……
あいつが死んで、
もうずいぶんと経つものなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: So it was a memento of your late wife... I'm so glad someone kind delivered it here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
亡くなった奥さんとの、
思い出の品だったんスね……
親切な人が届けてくれて、
よかったッス！

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you can say that again. Besides, you two were also a huge help, so thank you. As expected, the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE are quite reliable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
まったくだ。
それにお前さんたちも、
時間外だったのにありがとう。
やっぱり【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】は頼りになるな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Next time, please be careful not to drop them, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次からは、
落とさないように気を付けてくださいッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...Haah.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はぁ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: It's not that... I'm feeling a little guilty. I thought they were just "a pair of gloves", so I felt like I could deal with it later. I had no idea they were something so important to him that he couldn't get them back even if he paid money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃなくて……
反省してるッス。
ただの手袋だから、
後回しでいいなんて思ってたんスけど。
お金を払っても取り返しがつかない、
大切な物だったなんて。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If we hadn't given him a consultation, I'm sure that old man would've felt restless after returning home. Even if it was just for a night, that would be wrong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相談に乗ってあげなかったら、
あのおじいさん、
きっと
家に帰ってからも不安なままだったッス。
今夜だけの話だったとしても、
そんなの
間違ってるッス。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: The Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE are always there to help the citizens. Thanks to you setting an example for me, pal, I was able to remember my original calling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】は、いつでも市民の助けになる。
{0}さんがお手本を見せてくれたおかげで、
自分、
初心を思い出すことができたッス。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Getting rid of villains and looking after lost items are equally important jobs♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪党をやっつけるのも、
落とし物を捜してあげるのも、
同じくらい
大切なお仕事ッスね♪

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for working with me today, pal! I'll do my best to get myself fired up and be in charge at the lost items front desk tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……今日は、
一緒にお仕事してくれてありがとうッス！
気合を入れ直して、
明日からも落とし物係、
がんばるッス！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With {0}'s help, Matsuri was one step closer to becoming a full-fledged member of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}の助けも借りながら、
マツリはまた少し、一人前の
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】団員に近づいたのだった。
